defects: Finite numeric bounds and stable equal-value behavior were unspecified.

defects: Zero, negative and fractional sizes had no policy.

rationale: Define positive integer sizes 1..10000 and at most 1000 dense opaque items, accepting frozen arrays. Add original object/nested/undefined/null identity, fresh empty/oversized groups and a 1000-item uneven split. Preserve correct slice/loop/reducer reveals. Explain that disjoint slice windows copy each item once, supporting O(n) despite multiple group slices. Archived Czech remains unchanged.
